reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering artifacts, food, rings, goat products, fish, gold, a permanent animal treat, a quest item, and a golden coconut were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover archaeological uncertainty, collection radius, established item and fish names, permanent effects, item gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

GlassShards_Description.source: A mixture of glass shards smoothed by centuries of ocean surf. These could have belonged to an ancient mosaic or necklace.
GlassShards_Description.translation: Un amestec de cioburi de sticlă șlefuite de secole de valuri oceanice. Este posibil să fi făcut parte dintr-un mozaic sau colier antic.

GlazedYams_Description.source: Sweet and satisfying... The sugar gives it a hint of caramel.
GlazedYams_Description.translation: Dulci și sățioase... Zahărul le dă o ușoară aromă de caramel.

GlowstoneRing_Description.source: Emits a constant light, and also increases your radius for collecting items.
GlowstoneRing_Description.translation: Emite lumină constantă și îți mărește raza de colectare a obiectelor.

GoatCheese_Description.source: Soft cheese made from goat's milk.
GoatCheese_Description.translation: Brânză moale făcută din lapte de capră.

Goby_Description.source: Some types of Gobies can climb up waterfalls.
Goby_Description.translation: Unele specii de guvizi pot urca pe cascade.

GoldenAnimalCracker_Description.source: Give this to a farm animal to permanently double its produce yield. Doesn't work on pigs.
GoldenAnimalCracker_Description.translation: Dă-l unui animal de fermă pentru a-i dubla permanent producția. Nu funcționează la porci.

GoldenCoconut_Description.source: This is one tough nut to crack, but a professional might be able to break it open.
GoldenCoconut_Description.translation: Este o nucă foarte greu de spart, dar poate că un profesionist ar reuși s-o deschidă.
